## Description

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** All four exit criteria evidenced and confirmed.
- [ ] **AC2.** v1.0 release notes published; version tagged v1.0.0 from main.
- [ ] **AC3.** Journeys J1–J5 pass end-to-end on staging with the GA build.
